title: May 13 EOD — ATH day across the board. Market shrugged off hot PPI. China trip catalyst driving Mag 7.
macro: PPI April +1.4% monthly — biggest jump since March 2022. +6% YoY — biggest since December 2022. Market ignored it. S&P +0.58% ATH. Nasdaq +1.21%. Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, Elon Musk all on Trump-Xi summit delegation. AAPL hit $300 ATH. NVDA hit $227.56 ATH — market cap briefly $5.5T first company in history. VIX down 2.1% to 17.99. 10Y 4.473% highest since July 2025. 20Y and 30Y eclipsed 5%. Iran Trump-Xi summit ongoing — no escalation overnight. Oil pulling back slightly from $101+.
